postcards.note: per-site: postcards_by_site must hold one entry per site (a site that never sent appears with 0), every entry must be a count (a None/NaN/non-numeric entry is reported under per_site_non_numeric) and min over it > 1; the scalar postcards_min_per_site is accepted as the minimum of the engine-side WP5 invariant but cannot be checked for completeness; aggregate: mean per site (sum(postcards[t_sev:]) / n_radio_sites) > 1 -- the per-site check is then the engine-side WP5 invariant

run_length.note: every numeric per-tick series of a run, top-level and {name: series} member, has exactly t_total entries; n_series_checked / runs_checked say how much was compared, so an empty violations list is backed by a count instead of being indistinguishable from "no series was ever examined" (and a future breakage of _numeric_list shows up as a drop in the count, not as silence)

lifetimes.note: relay_lifetimes bridge records that carry no lifetime (no start tick, a start tick outside [0, t_total), or removed outside [start, t_total)); they are not counted by M11

M11.rule: Kaplan-Meier median per run; None when censoring keeps S(t) above 0.5
